Split the digit string into equal-width decimal row indices, using as many digits as the largest row index (rows count from 0); retain leading zeros. For each line, process indices backwards: remove the last field of that row as x; in each preceding row, bottom to top, replace its rightmost field strictly less than x with x and carry the replaced field as x. Compare fields in ASCII lexicographic order. Collect final x values, reverse their list. Concatenate block lists and join fields with LF. Blocks have 128 fields, except the last may be shorter. Empty fields are retained. Print only the exact joined text, with no added newline.
